name: ecopulse

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint:python
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=frontend && mypy --strict services/ packages/schemas/
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=frontend && ruff format services/ packages/

//overrides: Force a single React 19 across the whole workspace. Without this, npm hoists react@18 to the root and Next/framer-motion dedupe to it while the app uses react@19, causing element $$typeof mismatches (React error #31) during the production prerender.
